messages:
maria: Heads-up — prod cutover for payments service (payments-chart@1.4.0) starts in ~30m. Canary looks green in us-east but eu-west shows PVC attach errors on 3/10 canary pods. We have a 2h change window. Do we hold eu-west or proceed staggered?

deploy-bot: Automated preflight alert: pvc-attach-failure spike detected in eu-west-1 (rate ~30%). Canary health: 91% pass overall. Suggested action: pause regional promotion for eu-west OR fallback to stable chart@1.3.9 for eu-west. :warning:

alex: If it's PVC attach likely an attach/io flake on nodes — we can promote us-east and hold eu-west. Regional traffic split is supported, right @lee?

lee: Yep we can route eu-west to stable for now. I can apply a temporary namespace annotation + service selector change to keep traffic on the stable replica set. Need manual ok since it touches svc selectors.

tess: Quick check — are there DB migrations in this release? Release notes draft shows none. If no schema changes, a regional hold is fine.

maria: No migrations in this bump. Proposed plan:
1) Promote to us-east only now.
2) Pin eu-west to payments-chart@1.3.9 and disable autopromote for that region.
3) Add a release-notes note: "eu-west promotion pending pvc attach investigation".
4) Open ops ticket to gather CSI attach logs and node attach history.

alex: Commands I'll run (will wait for +1):
```bash
# promote to us-east only, leave eu-west staged
deploy-bot promote --chart payments-chart --version 1.4.0 --regions us-east --staged-hold eu-west
# add namespace annotation for visibility
kubectl annotate namespace payments release/promotion=staged --overwrite
```

deploy-bot: Promotion initiated to regions: us-east. Post-canary hooks passed for us-east. Annotation added: namespace/payments release/promotion=staged.

lee: Applying the traffic guard now — will patch service traffic weights so eu-west keeps stable. ETA ~4m. (will not touch DB settings) :mechanical_arm:

alex: I'll add the release-notes blurb now: "Payments v2 (1.4.0) promoted to us-east. eu-west held on 1.3.9 pending investigation into PVC attach failures; no schema changes. Global rollout will resume once issue cleared or a hotfix is released."

deploy-bot: Manual pin applied — eu-west pinned to payments-chart@1.3.9 until 2025-01-24T12:00Z. Canary autopromote disabled for eu-west.

maria: Thanks team. Can someone open the ops ticket and tag postmortem? Include CSI driver logs, k8s attach errors, recent node reboots, and any cloud-side attach latency graphs. Tag @oncall.

lee: Opening ticket now and adding runbook checklist (CSI logs, cloud attach traces, node drain history). @jordan please monitor.

jordan: Got the tag — I'll dig through CSI attach logs and the node autoscaler history, will report back in 15. :white_check_mark:

maria: OK — we'll continue the us-east cutover and keep eu-west pinned until we have root cause. I'll update release-notes draft and ship a short user-facing blurb mentioning regional stagger. :memo:
